source: tensorrt_llm.commands.serve (Click) + tensorrt_llm.llmapi.llm_args (Pydantic) + role UI buckets: prefill

server_role.description: Server role for disaggregated serving. CONTEXT=prefill (prompt processing), GENERATION=decode (token generation), MM_ENCODER=multimodal encoder, VISUAL_GEN=visual generation. Required when using service registry.

kv_connector_config.description: The config for KV cache connector.

kv_cache_config.default_value: enable_block_reuse=True max_tokens=None max_attention_window=None sink_token_length=None free_gpu_memory_fraction=0.9 host_cache_size=None cross_kv_cache_fraction=None secondary_offload_min_priority=None event_buffer_max_size=0 attention_dp_events_gather_period_ms=5 enable_partial_reuse=True copy_on_partial_reuse=True use_uvm=False max_gpu_total_bytes=0 iteration_stats_interval=1 dtype='auto' mamba_ssm_cache_dtype='auto' mamba_ssm_stochastic_rounding=False mamba_ssm_philox_rounds=10 tokens_per_block=32 use_kv_cache_manager_v2=False max_util_for_resume=0.95

backend.description: The backend to use to serve the model. Default is pytorch backend.

media_io_kwargs.description: Keyword arguments for media I/O as a JSON string. Keys are modality names ("video", "image", "audio") whose values are dicts of keyword arguments forwarded to the corresponding loader. Example: '{"video": {"extract_audio": true, "num_frames": 16}}' to enable audio extraction from video files.

video_pruning_rate.description: Pruning rate for video frames in multimodal models. Applied by Efficient Video Sampling (EVS). None disables EVS, values in [0, 1) enable pruning.

guided_decoding_backend.description: Guided decoding backend. llguidance is supported in PyTorch backend only.

reasoning_parser.description: Specify the parser for reasoning models. Use 'auto' to automatically select based on the model.

tool_parser.description: Specify the parser for tool models. Use 'auto' to automatically select based on the model.

custom_tokenizer.description: Custom tokenizer type: alias (e.g., 'deepseek_v32') or Python import path (e.g., 'tensorrt_llm.tokenizer.deepseek_v32.DeepseekV32Tokenizer').

max_beam_width.description: Maximum number of beams for beam search decoding.

num_postprocess_workers.description: Number of workers to postprocess raw responses to comply with OpenAI protocol.

custom_module_dirs.description: Paths to custom module directories to import.

gpus_per_node.description: Number of GPUs per node. Default to None, and it will be detected automatically.

revision.description: The revision to use for the HuggingFace model (branch name, tag name, or commit id). Prefer --hf_revision over --revision.

extra_llm_api_options.description: Path to a YAML file that overwrites the parameters specified by trtllm-serve. Can be specified as either --config or --extra_llm_api_options.

metadata_server_config_file.description: Path to metadata server config file

fail_fast_on_attention_window_too_large.description: [Deprecated] Exit with runtime error when attention window is too large to fit even a single sequence in the KV cache. Now defaults to True. This flag only affects the TRT backend and will be removed in a future release.

otlp_traces_endpoint.description: Target URL to which OpenTelemetry traces will be sent.

telemetry.description: Enable or disable anonymous usage telemetry collection.

chat_template.description: Specify a custom chat template. Can be a file path or one-liner template string

grpc.description: Run gRPC server instead of OpenAI HTTP server. gRPC server accepts pre-tokenized requests and returns raw token IDs.

extra_visual_gen_options.description: Path to a YAML file with extra VISUAL_GEN model options.

tokenizer_mode.description: The mode to initialize the tokenizer.

skip_tokenizer_init.description: Whether to skip the tokenizer initialization.

tokenizer_revision.description: The revision to use for the tokenizer.

model_kwargs.description: Optional parameters overriding model config defaults. Precedence: (1) model_kwargs, (2) model config file, (3) model config class defaults. Unknown keys are ignored

enable_lm_head_tp_in_adp.description: Enable LM head TP in attention dp.

pp_partition.description: Pipeline parallel partition, a list of each rank's layer number.

iter_stats_max_iterations.description: The maximum number of iterations for iter stats.

request_stats_max_iterations.description: The maximum number of iterations for request stats.

postprocess_tokenizer_dir.description: The path to the tokenizer directory for postprocessing.

mpi_session.description: The optional MPI session to use for this LLM instance.

perf_metrics_max_requests.description: The maximum number of requests for perf metrics. Must also set return_perf_metrics to true to get perf metrics.

prometheus_metrics_config.description: Configuration for Prometheus metrics collection, including custom histogram bucket boundaries.

enable_energy_metrics.description: Enable GPU energy monitoring via NVML. When enabled, the server exposes an /energy_metrics endpoint that reports cumulative GPU energy consumption in joules.

orchestrator_type.description: The orchestrator type to use. Defaults to None, which uses MPI.

env_overrides.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Environment variable overrides. NOTE: import-time-cached env vars in the code won't update unless the code fetches them from os.environ on demand.

calib_config.default_value: device='cuda' calib_dataset='cnn_dailymail' calib_batches=512 calib_batch_size=1 calib_max_seq_length=512 random_seed=1234 tokenizer_max_seq_length=2048

max_prompt_adapter_token.description: The maximum number of prompt adapter tokens.

garbage_collection_gen0_threshold.description: Threshold for Python garbage collection of generation 0 objects. Lower values trigger more frequent garbage collection.

cuda_graph_config.description: CUDA graph config. If true, use CUDA graphs for decoding.         CUDA graphs are only created for the batch sizes in cuda_graph_config.batch_sizes,         and are enabled for batches that consist of decoding requests *only*         (the reason is that it's hard to capture a single graph with prefill requests         since the input shapes are a function of the sequence lengths).         Note that each CUDA graph can use up to 200 MB of extra memory.

attention_dp_config.description: Optimized load-balancing for the DP Attention scheduler.

sampler_type.description: The type of sampler to use. Options are TRTLLMSampler, TorchSampler or auto. Defaults to auto, which will use TorchSampler. TRTLLMSampler is deprecated and will be removed in release 1.4.

sampler_force_async_worker.description: Force usage of the async worker in the sampler for D2H copies, even if confidential compute is not active. Normally, the async worker should only be used when confidential compute is active. This argument is provided to enable it for testing purposes, irrespective of confidential compute state.

enable_iter_req_stats.description: If true, enables per request stats per iteration. Must also set enable_iter_perf_stats to true to get request stats.

batch_wait_timeout_ms.description: If greater than 0, the request queue might wait up to batch_wait_timeout_ms to receive max_batch_size requests, if fewer than max_batch_size requests are currently available. If 0, no waiting occurs.

batch_wait_timeout_iters.description: Maximum number of iterations the scheduler will wait to accumulate new coming requests for improved GPU utilization efficiency. If greater than 0, the scheduler will delay batch processing to gather more requests up to the specified iteration limit. If 0, disables timeout-iters-based batching delays.

batch_wait_max_tokens_ratio.description: Token accumulation threshold ratio for batch scheduling optimization. If greater than 0, the scheduler will accumulate requests locally until the total token count reaches batch_wait_max_tokens_ratio * max_num_tokens. This mechanism enhances GPU utilization efficiency by ensuring adequate batch sizes. If 0, disables token-based batching delays.

enable_autotuner.description: Enable autotuner for all tunable ops. This flag is for debugging purposes only, and the performance may significantly degrade if set to false.

enable_layerwise_nvtx_marker.description: If true, enable layerwise nvtx marker.

enable_min_latency.description: If true, enable min-latency mode. Currently only used for Llama4.

stream_interval.description: The iteration interval to create responses under the streaming mode. Set this to a larger value when the batch size is large, which helps reduce the streaming overhead.

checkpoint_loader.description:
The checkpoint loader to use for this LLM instance. You may use a custom checkpoint loader by subclassing `BaseCheckpointLoader` and providing an instance of the subclass here to load weights from a custom checkpoint format.
If neither checkpoint_format nor checkpoint_loader are provided, checkpoint_format will be set to HF and the default HfCheckpointLoader will be used.
If checkpoint_format and checkpoint_loader are both provided, checkpoint_loader will be ignored.

checkpoint_format.description:
The format of the provided checkpoint. You may use a custom checkpoint format by subclassing `BaseCheckpointLoader` and registering it with `register_checkpoint_loader`.
If neither checkpoint_format nor checkpoint_loader are provided, checkpoint_format will be set to HF and the default HfCheckpointLoader will be used.
If checkpoint_format and checkpoint_loader are both provided, checkpoint_loader will be ignored.

mm_encoder_only.description: Only load/execute the vision encoder part of the full model. Defaults to False.

ray_worker_extension_cls.description: The full worker extension class name including module path. Allows users to extend the functions of the RayGPUWorker class.

ray_placement_config.description: Placement config for RayGPUWorker. Only used with AsyncLLM and orchestrator_type='ray'.

sleep_config.description: Configuration for the LLM sleep feature. Sleep feature requires extra setup that may slow down model loading. Only enable it if you intend to use this feature.

use_cute_dsl_blockscaling_mm.description: If true, use CuTe DSL fp8 blockscaling mm implementation.

use_cute_dsl_blockscaling_bmm.description: If true, use CuTe DSL fp8 blockscaling bmm implementation.

disable_flashinfer_sampling.description: Disable the use of FlashInfer.sampling. This option is likely to be removed in the future.

max_stats_len.description: The max number of performance statistic entries.

model.description: The path to the model checkpoint or the model name from the Hugging Face Hub.

dtype.description: The data type to use for the model.

served_model_name.description: The model name used in the API. If not specified, the model path is used as the model name. This is useful when the model path is long or when you want to expose a custom name to clients.

max_batch_size.description: Maximum number of requests that the engine can schedule.

max_num_tokens.description: Maximum number of batched input tokens after padding is removed in each batch.

tokenizer.description: Path or name of the tokenizer. When using the PyTorch backend, this replaces the default HuggingFace tokenizer.

max_seq_len.description: Maximum total length of one request, including prompt and outputs. If unspecified, the value is deduced from the model config.

moe_cluster_parallel_size.description: [Deprecated] Expert cluster parallelism size. This option is no longer supported and will be removed in a future release.

free_gpu_memory_fraction.description: Free GPU memory fraction reserved for KV Cache, after allocating model weights and buffers.

kv_cache_dtype.description: KV cache quantization dtype for PyTorch backend. 'auto' uses checkpoint/model metadata; explicit values force override.

moe_tensor_parallel_size.description: The tensor parallel size for MoE model's expert weights.

load_format.description: The format to load the model.

quant_config.default_value: quant_algo=None kv_cache_quant_algo=None group_size=128 smoothquant_val=0.5 clamp_val=None use_meta_recipe=False has_zero_point=False pre_quant_scale=False exclude_modules=None mamba_ssm_cache_dtype=None mamba_ssm_stochastic_rounding=False mamba_ssm_philox_rounds=10

force_dynamic_quantization.description: If true, force dynamic quantization. Defaults to False.
